Equities.title: Dow Jones Industrial Average rises as oil prices plunge on hopes for easing Iran pressure
Equities.summary: The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose to retest chart territory north of 48,000 on Tuesday, building on Monday's dramatic reversal. The S&P 500 and the Nasdaq Composite both gained ground as well as equity markets executed a broad turnaround.

Rates.title: CHF: SNB watches currency as inflation stays near zero – Nomura
Rates.summary: Nomura’s Global Markets Research Team argues that Switzerland’s low energy weight in CPI and hydropower reliance limit the inflation impact of higher Oil and gas prices.

Rates.title: Indonesia: Higher oil risks delay BI easing – Standard Chartered
Rates.summary: Standard Chartered economists maintain their call for Bank Indonesia to cut its policy rate by 25 bps in Q2-2026, but note that higher Oil prices and inflation now tilt risks toward a prolonged hold.

Rates.title: NOK: Inflation surprise challenges rate cut pricing – BBH
Rates.summary: Brown Brothers Harriman’s Elias Haddad highlights that the Norwegian Krone is underperforming as lower crude Oil prices weigh, even as Norway’s February inflation remains above Norges Bank projections.

FX.title: Forex Today: US Dollar slips as Oil stabilizes after Trump comment
FX.summary: Better market sentiment is taking its toll on the Greenback as stabilizing Oil prices give riskier positions more appeal to investors.

FX.title: Gold rises above $5,200 as softer USD and yields offer support
FX.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) trades on a firm note on Tuesday, building on the previous day’s rebound from levels near $5,000.

FX.title: USD/CAD: Consolidation holds with firm support – Scotiabank
FX.summary: Scotiabank strategists Shaun Osborne and Eric Theoret highlight that the Canadian Dollar is modestly firmer against a softer Dollar, supported by narrower 1-year swap spreads and resilient risk appetite despite lower Oil.

Commodities.title: Oil retreats even after Energy Secretary wrongly claims Navy escorted tanker through Strait of Hormuz
Commodities.summary: The International Energy Agency will hold an extraodrinary meeting on Tuesday to discuss a possible release of emergency stockpiles.

Commodities.title: WTI Oil prices fall as G7 considers reserve release, IEA calls emergency meeting
Commodities.summary: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) US Oil corrects lower on Tuesday, with the price trading around $82.30 at the time of writing, down 1.15% on the day as markets reassess supply risks following comments from international energy officials.

Commodities.title: Japan's Industry Minister Akazawa: Discussed the energy situation and possible oil reserves
Commodities.summary: Ryosei Akazawa, Japanese Minister of Economy, Trade and Industry, said that he discussed the energy situation and the possibility of releasing oil reserves with G7 energy ministers in a Reuters News on Tuesday.
